cohort: 200 women who underwent repeat C-sections at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Santhiram Medical College, Nandyal, between October 2012 and September 2013.
finding: Appropriate prenatal care, adequate preoperative preparation, meticulous surgical techniques, and careful postoperative follow-up can dramatically reduce intraoperative and postoperative morbidity associated with repeat C-sections.
